description: This file defines the PerformanceReviewFinalEvaluationAPI class, which handles API endpoints for final evaluation operations on performance reviews, including updating (finalizing) and retrieving specific review data. It integrates with services, validation, and authorization mechanisms within the OrangeHRM performance module.

classes.name: PerformanceReviewFinalEvaluationAPI
classes.description: API class for handling final evaluation operations on performance reviews, including updating (finalizing) and fetching review data.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Handles PUT request to finalize and update a performance review, including transaction management and permission checks.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Handles GET request to retrieve a finalized performance review by ID.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Not implemented; throws an exception if called.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Returns validation rules for the update (finalize) operation.

methods.name: getFinalEvaluationBodyParamRules
methods.description: Defines validation rules for the request body parameters related to final evaluation.

methods.name: setFinalEvaluation
methods.description: Sets final rating, comment, and completion date on a PerformanceReview object based on request parameters.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Returns validation rules to validate GET request parameters for retrieving a review.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Returns validation rules for delete operation, which is not implemented.
